abstract: This report aims to present the imaging findings of an ovarian teratoma incidentally detected during fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) positron emission tomography combined with computed tomography (PET/CT) examination performed for the staging of gastric carcinoma, and to discuss these findings in the context of the current literature. A 53-year-old woman with a recently confirmed diagnosis of gastric carcinoma via endoscopic biopsy was referred for PET/CT staging. Imaging revealed pathological FDG uptake along the gastric wall from the cardia to the lesser curvature, consistent with the primary tumor. Additionally, a well-circumscribed, smoothly marginated pelvic mass with no appreciable FDG uptake was identified, demonstrating tooth-like calcifications and fatty fluid components on CT. Given its mixed-density composition, ovarian teratoma was considered the primary differential diagnosis, which was subsequently confirmed on targeted ultrasonography. Mature cystic teratoma typically presents as a metabolically inactive lesion on PET/CT; however, its characteristic CT morphology allows for reliable incidental identification. Awareness of incidental ovarian pathologies encountered during PET/CT examinations performed for unrelated malignancies is of considerable clinical importance.
abstract_ja: 本報告は、胃癌の病期分類目的で行われた陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)/コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で偶発的に発見された卵巣奇形腫の画像所見を提示し、現在の文献と照らし合わせて考察することを目的とします。内視鏡生検で胃癌と確定診断された53歳女性がPET/CT病期分類のため紹介されました。画像では、噴門から小弯にかけての胃壁に沿った病的なFDG集積が認められ、原発腫瘍に一致していました。さらに、FDG集積のない境界明瞭で滑らかな辺縁を有する骨盤内腫瘤が同定され、CTでは歯牙様石灰化と脂肪性液体成分が認められました。混合密度の組成から、卵巣奇形腫が主要な鑑別診断として挙げられ、標的超音波検査で確認されました。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は通常、PET/CTで代謝的に不活性な病変として示されますが、特徴的なCT形態により信頼性の高い偶発的同定が可能です。悪性腫瘍に対するPET/CT検査の際に偶然見つかる卵巣病変の認識は、きわめて重要です。
